section: 5 - STABILIZE FOREX SESSION AND KILL-ZONE LOGIC
method: Verification checkpoint over already-mature, already-DST-tested logic (scanner/session_engine.py), re-verified after the checkpoint 4 entry_allowed fix landed in the same module.
session_timezone: America/New_York, via zoneinfo.ZoneInfo -- DST-correct by construction (no manual EST/EDT branching)
new_york_pm_kill_zone: Not formally supported by the current session engine (only London + NY AM kill zones are defined) -- per §5's own conditional wording ('New York PM kill zone when formally supported'), this is correctly omitted rather than fabricated.

dst_verification.conclusion: Same session correctly identified at the equivalent local time across the DST transition, with the correct EST/EDT label -- re-confirmed after the checkpoint 4 fix; tests/test_session_engine.py::test_winter_uses_est / ::test_summer_uses_edt_without_shifting_session (both pre-existing, both still passing) already assert this at the unit level.

session_gating_scope.may_gate_ict_models_only_when_required: PASS -- session_ok in analysis/auto_strategy_router.py::_ict_candidate is only computed and applied for the ICT candidate; supply_demand and breakout_retest candidates do not consult session context at all.
session_gating_scope.does_not_create_direction_by_itself: PASS -- entry_allowed only ever narrows (ANDs into) eligibility; direction is determined entirely by structure (top_down alignment, sweep/displacement/MSS direction), never by which session is currently active.
session_gating_scope.forex_session_logic_does_not_affect_deri: PASS, structurally guaranteed -- app.py's derived/Deriv branch constructs a hardcoded {'entry_allowed': True, 'market_status': 'OPEN_24_7', ...} object and never calls scanner/session_engine.py at all; the derived analysis path has no reference to this module.
